name: CLI & Presentation Layer
description: User-facing command-line interface, interactive REPL loop, and formatted terminal output rendering using Typer and Rich.

name: Core Inference Engine Layer
description: Orchestration of Afro-centric transformer representations, clause extraction, preprocessing, and polarity probability inference.

name: Text Preprocessing & Normalization Layer
description: O(N) Ge'ez orthographic normalization, homophone unification, labiovelar reduction, and punctuation hygiene.

name: Decision Logic & Calibration Layer
description: Mathematical formulation and continuous decoupled dual-axis thresholding for positive, negative, neutral, and mixed sentiments.

name: Test Harness & Golden Benchmarks Layer
description: Automated pytest test suite, unit tests for preprocessor and calibration math, and the 10 Golden Benchmark cases dataset.

name: Documentation & Specifications Layer
description: Project documentation, README, dependency specifications, requirement specs, and architectural plans.

name: Autonomous Governance & Telemetry Layer
description: State tracking, planning consensus records, code review verdicts, QA test records, and execution telemetry ledgers.
